Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Electrician. This is a contract-based position at TMC ACTREC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Electrician post. The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Electrician position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Electrician position ranges from Rs. 26,210 to Rs. 35,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC with ITI in Electrician (2 years) or NCVT certification with 2 years experience, or a Wireman License with 5 years experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Electrician post is 33 years. Age relaxation may be provided based on experience.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 28th September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified venue on this date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to carry original and self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the TMC ACTREC located?
faq.answer: TMC ACTREC is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.
